purpose: Store official winner-location evidence for later exposure-adjusted analysis; geography is not assumed causal or predictive.
forbiddenInference: Do not infer winner location from media when SELAE is available.
Do not treat raw winner counts by place as edge.
Do not use post-draw winner geography to predict the same draw.
Do not rank administrations without an exposure denominator such as sales, tickets, stakes, population or another predeclared proxy.
Do not merge multiple prize categories into jackpot evidence without preserving category.
requiredNulls: permutation of draw dates preserving location/exposure marginals
prospectiveRule: Any geographic feature must be computed using information available strictly before the target draw and frozen before evaluation.

officialEvidenceObserved.exampleVerified: La Primitiva 2026-07-16 official result page records one first-category winner; locality must be ingested only if published by SELAE in the corresponding official detail/press release.
